## Purpose

Export batching interval, 1–60 seconds.

## Constraints and authority

Public schema path: `/observability/export_interval_seconds`. minimum: 1; maximum: 60. Branch-specific requirements and native permission/identity checks still apply; schema input acceptance alone is not authority. Use synthetic declarations in the preview and keep credential bytes outside policy.

## Expected result

The local proposal contains the intended declaration and passes complete-policy validation. Browser Save retains a local draft; it does not activate native configuration, fetch a provider value or grant remote access. Use the corresponding guide for actual native operations.

## Recovery

On invalid signal/update settings, correct the selected object and validate again. Do not put token bytes in the policy; a collector/feed failure is not permission to retry completed sensitive work.
